scope: Extant Palm Tree Mosque at 185 Long Street, with Cape Georgian frontage, lowered threshold and mapped rear ranges.

references.caption: This mosque, converted from a house, stands on lands once owned by Hermanus Smuts, granted to him in 1751. It is at 186 Long Street, Cape Town.
references.alt: This mosque, converted from a house, stands on lands once owned by Hermanus Smuts, granted to him in 1751. It is at 186 Long Street, Cape Town.

originalReview.notes: The exact Arthur Elliott image establishes the flat parapet and cross cornice, plain rendered walls, six-bay two-storey arrangement with a door at the central lower bay, and low planting walls along Long Street.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s exact Arthur Elliott photo matched the native Commons original and named Cape Archives record. A4 Arts Foundation and the architectural register independently identify this same archive photograph as public domain. The 1943 image is omitted because its recorded file date is 2012 and no specific creator is named.
